name: virtual-breadboard-mobile
description: Capacitor (Android) packaging of the Virtual Breadboard Simulator. Wraps the same index.html + style.css + js/ engine as the browser and Electron builds -- no rewrite of circuit.js.

scripts.android:sync: npm run www && npm run android:add && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.js assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk-release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.js assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.js bundleRelease
